judgments.reason: The model never articulated a mechanism that the three-coin commission is applied before payment or that this allows bids above coins to win; transcript and model_articulation show standard pay-then-commission accounting (winner pays bid and then receives commission), not the claimed rule-order bug.

The model did not state a hypothesis that waiting reveals already-committed sealed rival bids before you commit, nor link that mechanism to an observed outcome; clerk revelations appear in the transcript but the model never claimed or explained using waiting to see rivals' sealed bids prior to committing.

The model did not articulate that a 'close' action can settle the game with unauctioned lots remaining; the transcript and rules describe settlement after all three lots are sold and unresolved lots at horizon remain unsold, but no mechanism or discovery was claimed by the model.

The model did not assert or explain that catalog purchases receive the three-coin auction commission; the rules and transcript distinguish catalog buys from auction wins and the model made no discovery describing such substitution.
